Adele Morgan: FYI - Windfall saw an unexpected embeddings cost jump after enabling continuous reindexing. Need a tiny QBR-ready remediation + a customer-friendly note. cc @Kai
Kai Zhou: Checking numbers. 24h burn = $6.3k, projected 30d @ current = ~$189k. Typical run-rate ~ $45k/mo. Credits remaining = $28k, retainer = $15k/mo, retainer expires in 19 days.
Rafael Ortiz: Is it bulk indexing or live queries? If indexing, we can suggest staged reindex + cheaper model.
Kai Zhou: Indexing is the main driver (about 66%). They flipped on continuous reindex to keep embeddings fresh. Avg seq length ~ 950 tokens.
Adele Morgan: For the QBR slide I want: 1) one-liner what happened, 2) immediate mitigation we applied, 3) recommended next steps (enablement + runway ask). Keep it short.
Rafael Ortiz: Quick mitigation we applied: paused continuous reindex, reduced indexer concurrency from 10 -> 2, and swapped indexer model to q4-8bit for the remainder of the window.
monitor-bot: ALERT: WINDFALL account crossed 65% credits at 1775559800. Owner notified.
Kai Zhou: Scenario numbers for slide: status_quo = $189k, quantized+throttle = $104k, pause-reindex = $58k. Note: pause reduces freshness.
Adele Morgan: Draft auto-throttle snippet for slide: ```yaml
policy: windfall_budget_guard
soft_usd: 20000
hard_usd: 30000
soft_action: email-cs + warn-customer
hard_action: pause-reindex + swap-to-quantized-embed
```
Rafael Ortiz: Ops CLI for appendix: ```bash
# pause continuous reindex
rwctl jobs pause --account WINDFALL --job continuous-reindex
# reduce concurrency
rwctl jobs update --account WINDFALL --job continuous-reindex --concurrency 2
# swap indexer model
rwctl accounts set-model --account WINDFALL --route embeddings --model open-embed-q4-8bit --batch-size 64
```
Adele Morgan: Enablement offer (one-liner for slide): "30-minute ingest & cost stabilization workshop: well tune reindex cadence, enable batching and model fallbacks; includes 10-day monitoring and rollback support."
Kai Zhou: I'll add a tiny sparkline for projected runway and paste numbers into the deck. Rafael, please prepare the 2-line customer note framing this as "predictability package" and request 30% staged retainer top-up.
Rafael Ortiz: Draft note ready, will paste here and send to AE for review.
billing-bot: Account WINDFALL: credits_remaining=28000, monthly_retainer=15000, retainer_expiry=2026-04-07, auto_renew=false.
Adele Morgan: Meeting 16:00 to finalize slides. Quick and tidy. :thumbsup:
